name: Boeing 737 MAX 8
sources: [MAX] Boeing D6-38A004 Rev H https://www.boeing.com/content/dam/boeing/v2/airports/acaps/737MAX_RevH.pdf: span 35.92 m; the AT winglet 2.92 m from the lower blade's tip to the upper's (fig 2-10); off the drawing: the upper blade 2.4 m long rising 2.1 m (29° outboard), leading edge 39° and trailing edge 18° in side view, chord 1.35 m to 0.3 m; the lower blade 1.25 m, 32° below horizontal, leading edge 65-70°, chord 1.0 m to 0.35 m; the junction about 16.8 m from the centre line. [NG] D6-58325-7 Rev C https://www.boeing.com/content/dam/boeing/v2/airports/acaps/737NG_REV_C.pdf: 737-800 span 35.79 m with winglets, 34.32 m without.

Nacelles [NG]/[MAX]: CFM56-7B fan 61 in, LEAP-1B 69.4 in (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CFM_International_LEAP); nacelle about 3.2 m inlet to fan exhaust, 1.97 m tall (737-800) vs 3.76 m, inlet 2.19 m tall (MAX 8); inlet 13.36 m vs 13.00 m from the nose (0.36 m forward); engine axis about 0.2 m higher; clearance 0.48 m (800) vs 0.43 m (MAX 8) at MTOW. Width estimated 2.25 m vs 2.55 m. The 737-800 mesh's cowl measures 2.19 × 1.99 m.
